operations.command:
set -e; for unit in generate-sb-keys.service; do for i in $(seq 1 240); do result=$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$result" = success ]; then break; fi; if [ "$result" = exit-code ]; then systemctl status "$unit"; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value "$unit")" = success; done; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) fallback=BOOTX64.EFI; systemd=systemd-bootx64.efi ;; aarch64) fallback=BOOTAA64.EFI; systemd=systemd-bootaa64.efi ;; *) fallback=BOOTUNKNOWN.EFI; systemd=systemd-bootunknown.efi ;; esac; verify=$(sbctl verify); printf '%s
' "$verify"; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q "/boot/EFI/BOOT/$fallback is signed"; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q "/boot/EFI/systemd/$systemd is signed"; printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/Linux/.* is signed'; if printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q "/boot/EFI/BOOT/$fallback is not signed"; then exit 1; fi; if printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q "/boot/EFI/systemd/$systemd is not signed"; then exit 1; fi; ! printf '%s
' "$verify" | grep -q '/boot/EFI/Linux/.* is not signed'
